trigger.description: The workspace has an existing manual peer configuration (a peer group was previously created by hand or by another tool) and the operator invoked `ee mesh auto-enroll` without --replace-manual-with-auto. SRR6.46.3 refuses to silently switch the workspace from the manual-managed to the auto-managed lifecycle; this code surfaces so the operator makes the migration explicit.
setup_commands: ee mesh peer add <node-key> --workspace .   # or any equivalent manual peer configuration step
